theorems.name: Submission.rsod_tv_tangentProj_eq
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U U' : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (W : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U') (x₀ : Amb n ℓ), W.carrier = (fun y => y + x₀) ⁻¹' V.carrier → (∀ y, W.mult y = V.mult (y + x₀)) → ∀ y, W.tangentProj y = V.tangentProj (y + x₀)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
